backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing a marketplace with listing management (create, read, update, delete, search, filter by category/location/price), user profiles, blob storage mixin, and role-based access control with admin/user permissions.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features documented.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON summaries of all frontend components, pages, hooks, and configuration files describing the OLS marketplace UI implementation with authentication, listings, search, and Indian locale formatting.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide for configuring custom domain (www.ols.in) on Internet Computer with DNS setup instructions.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives and OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables for marketplace UI including sidebar, charts, and semantic colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with OLS branding, SEO meta tags for Indian marketplace, favicon references, and root div for React app mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for browse, listing detail, create listing, and dashboard pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider with shared Header/Footer layout and ProfileSetupModal.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button component that opens MobileAuthModal for login via OTP flow and handles logout with query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/MobileAuthM: Modal dialog implementing two-step mobile OTP authentication with phone number input, OTP verification with countdown timer, resend functionality, and Indian country code (+91) prefix.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Non-dismissible modal for new users to complete profile setup after OTP verification, with input sanitization, email/phone validation, and pre-populated phone field from auth context.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/UserLi: Card component for displaying user's own listings with edit, view, and mark-as-sold actions. Includes dialogs for editing listing details and confirming sold status.
frontend/src/components/filters/Category: Filter component with buttons for selecting product categories (electronics, vehicles, real estate, furniture, fashion, services) or viewing all categories.
frontend/src/components/filters/Location: Text input filter for searching listings by location with clear button functionality.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Application footer displaying copyright, branding, and attribution link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Main navigation header with logo, browse link, authenticated user actions (dashboard, post ad), and login button.
frontend/src/components/listings/CreateL: Form component for creating new listings with fields for title, description, price, category, location, contact info, and image uploads with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/listings/EditLis: Form component for editing existing listings, pre-populated with current listing data and supporting image management.
frontend/src/components/listings/ImageGa: Image carousel component with thumbnail navigation, previous/next controls, and placeholder support for listings without images.
frontend/src/components/listings/Listing: Card component for displaying listing preview with thumbnail, title, price, location, date, and sold badge in browse/search views.
Responsive grid layout wrapper that renders multiple ListingCard components in a responsive column layout.
frontend/src/components/search/SearchBar: A search input component with a search icon on the left and a clear button (X) on the right that appears when there's a value.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing identity state and delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useMobileAuth.ts: A mobile OTP authentication provider that wraps Internet Identity for UI compatibility, simulating SMS OTP flows with phone number validation, rate limiting, and expiry handling (currently mocked for development).
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles and listings data, including queries for active listings, search, category/location filtering, and user-specific listings.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors including primary, secondary, accent, destructive, and sidebar color schemes using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/BrowsePage.tsx: Main marketplace browsing page with hero section, search bar, category/location filters, and a listing grid that displays filtered results based on search term, category, or location.
frontend/src/pages/CreateListingPage.tsx: Page for creating new listings that checks for authentication and renders a CreateListingForm component with a back button navigation.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard page component that displays authenticated user's listings in a grid, with options to create new listings and handles loading/empty states.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailPage.tsx: Listing detail page showing full item information with image gallery, description, price, location, and contact details with authentication-gated contact reveal functionality.
frontend/src/utils/config.ts: Configuration utilities providing base URL detection for custom domain (www.ols.in) and app constants including name, support email, and OTP settings.
frontend/src/utils/currency.ts: Currency formatting utilities for INR with Indian numbering system, handling conversion between bigint storage format and display/input formats.
frontend/src/utils/security.ts: Security utilities providing input sanitization for XSS prevention, validation functions for phone/email/OTP, and phone number formatting for Indian numbers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities supporting both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and parameter cleanup functions.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme settings, container queries, typography, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document describing OLS marketplace platform with mobile OTP authentication, INR pricing, custom domain (www.ols.in), and noting a deployment accessibility issue.
